up: Return all activity rows for assay CHEMBL4725213. Include the exact activity values (standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units), the canonical SMILES structure, and the compound ChEMBL ID and pref_name.
sql:
SELECT
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4725213';
